fanPetitionDraftObjectives.body:
A wave of {{team}} supporters has organized a campaign asking for a clearer draft identity and sharper objective setups.

"We want proactive plans on the Rift, not passive scaling every series. Show us the team knows how it wants to win."

The thread is gaining traction across esports social channels. How do you respond?

cleanWinObjectives.text: Your bot lane stacked dragons and controlled Baron. How much of this win came from objective setup?

firstBlood.text: You found first blood and the map opened up from there. Was that a prepared play or a read in the moment?

resultWin.text: An important win with strong objective control. How do you assess the team's performance today?

closeGame.text: The game got difficult, but you found the comeback late. What changed in the team's communication?

underperformancePressure.text: Your bot lane struggled under pressure tonight. Is this becoming a pattern?

draftLoss.text: After draft, it looked like you lacked tools for the key fights. Do you accept that part of the series was lost there?

draftWinFlexibility.text: The draft gave you several win conditions and the team looked comfortable changing plans. Was that flexibility the main idea?

baronThrowLoss.text: The call around Baron ended up turning the game. Was that a shotcalling mistake or an execution mistake?

baronControlWin.text: Your Baron control was very clean and forced the opponent to answer late. How much had you worked on that setup?

visionControlLoss.text: The opponent denied you vision in the decisive moments, and that shaped the objectives. What broke down in your map control?

starPlayerCarry.text: Your carry decided another huge game. How do you give them space to shine without putting too much responsibility on them?

starPlayerSlump.text: One of your key players has not found their level in recent weeks. Are you concerned about their confidence?

midlanePressureMap.text: Mid lane pressure shaped a lot of the map movements. Was mid the piece you wanted to activate from the start?

toplaneIsland.text: Your top laner spent much of the game isolated, almost on an island. Was that tactical or an adaptation to the opponent's draft?

teamfightExecutionLoss.text: In the decisive teamfights, the coordination was missing and the opponent punished every engage. What did you lack to close those fights?

mentalResetAfterLoss.text: That is a tough loss for the group. How do you protect the room so it does not carry into the next series?

rivalryWeekPressure.text: Rivalry week brings noise outside the game and pressure on the Rift. Does preparing this match feel different?

playoffBestOfSeries.text: In a best-of series, adjustments matter so much. How important is it to adapt quickly between games?

comebackLossHeartbreak.text: You came very close to completing the comeback, but the finish slipped away. How do you process a loss like that?

stompWinHumility.text: You won with real authority and barely gave them a way in. How do you keep the team humble after a game like that?

stompLossAccountability.text: The loss was clear from the opening minutes. What responsibility do you take as staff for a game that difficult?

creditPreparation.label: Professional
creditPreparation.text: The players earned that through draft prep and clean objective calls.

admitDraftMistake.label: Admit draft mistake
admitDraftMistake.text: The draft did not give us the best tools, and that is on us. We have to learn from it without hiding from it.

calmRivalry.label: Calm the rivalry
calmRivalry.text: We understand what it means to the fans, but for us it still has to be a well-prepared game played with a clear head.

challengeRoster.label: Challenge the roster
challengeRoster.text: That level is not enough. Players and staff alike have to compete with more presence from the first minute.

creditOpponent.label: Credit opponent
creditOpponent.text: The opponent played the key moments better. Recognising that is the first step toward fixing what we lacked.

demandReset.label: Demand reset
demandReset.text: We have to reset standards immediately; pressure is part of playing at this level.

defendDraft.label: Defend draft
defendDraft.text: The draft plan made sense for what we wanted to play. The difference was how we executed the important windows.

focusNextSeries.label: Focus next series
focusNextSeries.text: We need to review honestly, but we cannot stay stuck here. The next series starts with our mental reset.

keepHungry.label: Keep hungry
keepHungry.text: It is a good win, but it does not change our standards. If we want to compete at the top, tomorrow we work the same way.

leanIntoRivalry.label: Lean into rivalry
leanIntoRivalry.text: These games are played with something extra. We like that pressure, and we want our fans to feel we came for everything.

praiseShotcalling.label: Praise shotcalling
praiseShotcalling.text: The calls were very clear, especially around waves and objectives. When the team communicates like that, the plan looks much stronger.

protectPlayer.label: Protect player
protectPlayer.text: I am not going to single out a player publicly. We win and lose as a team, and we will do the analysis inside.

stayMeasured.label: Stay measured
stayMeasured.text: One result does not define our form. We review it and move forward.

takeResponsibility.label: Take responsibility
takeResponsibility.text: Responsibility starts with me. If the team was not ready for those moments, we have to correct that from the staff.

playerPressureReset.body:
{{player}} has asked for a private reset after a rough scrim block. Their morale is at {{morale}}, and they feel stage pressure is starting to affect team comms.

"I need to reset before this pressure follows me into the next series, coach."

playerStageTimeRequest.body:
{{player}} came in frustrated about limited stage reps. They feel their scrims have been strong and want clarity on what earns a spot in the next series.

"If I'm not in the stage plan, I need to know what has to change."

playerHighFormCheckin.body:
{{player}} checked in after a strong run of solo queue and team practice. They're enjoying the draft room clarity and believe the roster is close to finding another level.

"Keep the structure like this and I'll bring that confidence onto stage."

playerContractPressure.body:
{{player}} wants clarity before the next league window. With {{days}} days left on the deal, they ask whether they remain part of the roster plan or should prepare for other offers.

"I need to know if this project still has a place for me after the split."

Use this break to assess your squad, make any necessary changes, and prepare for the challenges ahead.

Good luck!

low_morale_1.subject: Morale concern: {{player}}
low_morale_1.body:
Coach, we've noticed that {{player}}'s morale has dropped significantly. Currently at {{morale}}%.

This could affect their performance in matches and training. It might be worth having a word with them to understand what's going on.

low_morale_2.subject: {{player}} seems unhappy
low_morale_2.body:
I wanted to bring this to your attention — {{player}} appears to be unhappy (morale: {{morale}}%).

If left unaddressed, this could create tension in the squad. A conversation or some time off might help lift their spirits.

bench_complaint_1.subject: {{player}} wants more game time
bench_complaint_1.body:
Coach, {{player}} has expressed frustration about their lack of playing time recently.

They feel they deserve a spot in the starting lineup. This could become a bigger issue if not managed carefully.

How would you like to handle this?

bench_complaint_2.subject: {{player}} unhappy with squad role
bench_complaint_2.body:
{{player}} came to see me today — they're unhappy with their current role in the squad and want more opportunities on the Rift.

If we can't offer them more playtime soon, they may look for a transfer in the next window.

Your call, coach.

happy_player_1.subject: {{player}} is feeling great!
happy_player_1.body:
Good news, coach — {{player}} is in high spirits lately (morale: {{morale}}%).

Happy players perform better, so keep up whatever you're doing with them. A positive squad atmosphere makes a real difference.

happy_player_2.subject: Positive vibes from {{player}}
happy_player_2.body:
Just wanted to share that {{player}} is really enjoying their time at the club right now (morale: {{morale}}%).

They've been training hard and supporting teammates. It's great to see such a positive attitude in the squad.

Keep nurturing that environment!

contract_concern_1.subject: Contract running down: {{player}}
contract_concern_1.body:
I wanted to remind you that {{player}}'s contract is expiring soon ({{days}} days remaining).

If we don't act soon, we risk losing them for nothing. We should consider opening renewal negotiations or listing them for transfer.

What's your plan for {{player}}?

contract_concern_2.subject: {{player}} contract expiring in {{days}} days
contract_concern_2.body:
This is a reminder about {{player}}'s contract situation. With only {{days}} days left on their current deal, we need to make a decision.

Options:
• Open renewal negotiations
• List them for transfer while they still have value
• Let the contract expire

Please advise on how you'd like to proceed.

encourage.label: Encourage them
encourage.description: Show empathy and encourage the player to keep working hard.

promiseTime.label: Promise more playing time
promiseTime.description: Tell them they'll get their chance — bigger morale boost but sets expectations.

workHarder.label: Tell them to work harder
workHarder.description: Tough love approach — could backfire or motivate them.

explain.label: Explain the situation
explain.description: Calmly explain squad competition and rotation. Steady morale boost.

promiseChance.label: Promise them a chance soon
promiseChance.description: They'll be happier but will expect to start in upcoming matches.

proveYourself.label: Tell them to prove themselves
proveYourself.description: Challenge them to earn their place. Risky — could motivate or frustrate.

praiseBack.label: Return the praise
praiseBack.description: Tell them how much you value their contribution.

stayProfessional.label: Stay professional
stayProfessional.description: Acknowledge their form but keep things measured.

higherExpectations.label: Set higher expectations
higherExpectations.description: Challenge them to reach an even higher level. Could push or pressure.

reassure.label: Reassure them about renewal
reassure.description: Tell them you want them to stay. Big morale boost.

noncommittal.label: Be noncommittal
noncommittal.description: Keep your options open. Player may become unsettled.

noRenewal.label: Tell them you won't renew
noRenewal.description: Honest but brutal. Morale will tank.

proveYourself.positive: Player is fired up to prove their worth. Morale {{delta}}
proveYourself.negative: Player feels dismissed and insulted. Morale {{delta}}

happyPlayer.praiseBack: Player beams at the praise. Morale {{delta}}

higherExpectations.positive: Player rises to the challenge. Morale {{delta}}
higherExpectations.negative: Player feels the pressure is unfair. Morale {{delta}}

contractConcern.reassure: Player is reassured about their future. Morale {{delta}}

noncommittal.positive: Player grudgingly accepts for now. Morale {{delta}}
noncommittal.negative: Player is unsettled and unhappy. Morale {{delta}}

sponsor.subject: Sponsorship Offer — {{sponsor}}
sponsor.body:
Good news, boss! {{sponsor}} has expressed interest in becoming a sponsor of {{team}}.

They are offering a one-time payment of €{{amount}} for the upcoming split in exchange for advertising space on the club's banners.

This seems like a reasonable deal, but it is your call.

decline.label: Decline politely
decline.description: Turn down the offer. No financial impact.

media_neg_1.subject: Media questions {{team}}'s direction
media_neg_1.body:
A recent article questions the direction {{team}} is heading under the current coaching staff. The piece points to inconsistent results and a lack of clear identity.

"{{team}} seems to be going backwards," the analyst stated.

The pressure is mounting.

media_neg_10.subject: Pressure mounts on {{team}} management
media_neg_10.body:
Media pressure is mounting on the management of {{team}} following a poor run of results. Several outlets are calling for changes in the coaching staff.

"How much longer will the board tolerate this?" one article asks.

The temperature is rising in the hot seat.

media_neg_2.subject: Criticism grows over {{team}}'s performances
media_neg_2.body:
Criticism is growing in the media over {{team}}'s recent performances. Several commentators have questioned the team's preparation and tactical approach.

"There are no excuses for this level of performance," one pundit said.

The fans are starting to voice their concerns on social media.

media_neg_3.subject: "Is {{team}} in crisis?" asks sports website
media_neg_3.body:
A popular sports website has published an article questioning whether {{team}} is in crisis mode. The piece highlights the team's slide down the standings.

"Something needs to change, and fast," the article concludes.

The spotlight is firmly on the coaching staff.

media_neg_4.subject: Analyst slams {{team}}'s recent form
media_neg_4.body:
A well-known analyst has been critical of {{team}}'s recent form, describing it as "unacceptable for a team with this roster."

The criticism comes at a difficult time, with the team struggling to find consistency.

Media scrutiny is intensifying with every poor result.

media_neg_5.subject: "{{team}} underachieving" says league roundup
media_neg_5.body:
The weekly league roundup has labeled {{team}} as the most underachieving team of the split.

"With the resources at their disposal, {{team}} should be performing much better," the roundup states.

The narrative is becoming increasingly negative around the club.

media_neg_6.subject: Social media criticizes {{team}} coach
media_neg_6.body:
Social media is buzzing with criticism directed at the {{team}} coaching staff after a string of disappointing results.

Fans are calling for changes and questioning the tactical decisions being made.

Online pressure can sometimes affect the dressing room.

media_neg_7.subject: "What's wrong with {{team}}?" — opinion piece
media_neg_7.body:
An opinion piece titled "What's wrong with {{team}}?" has been published, analyzing the team's struggles in detail.

The author suggests that the team's issues run deeper than just tactics, pointing to potential morale problems.

Opinion pieces like this can influence public perception.

media_neg_8.subject: {{player}} underperforming, says media report
media_neg_8.body:
A media report has highlighted {{player}}'s recent drop in form, questioning whether the player's potential is being maximized under the current coaching staff.

"{{player}} is a talented player who seems to be regressing," the report states.

Individual player form is often attributed to coaching quality.

media_neg_9.subject: "{{team}} needs a rebuild" claims article
media_neg_9.body:
A provocative article claims that {{team}} needs a complete rebuild, starting from the coaching staff down.

The piece argues that the current project has run its course and fresh leadership is needed.

Articles like this can create unrest if they gain traction.

media_pos_1.subject: Sports media praises {{team}}'s turnaround
media_pos_1.body:
Local sports media has highlighted {{team}}'s impressive turnaround this season. The article praises the team's tactical discipline and fighting spirit.

"{{team}} looks like a completely different squad under this coaching staff," the report states.

Keep up the good work, coach — the media is taking notice.

media_pos_10.subject: {{team}}'s coach named coach of the week
media_pos_10.body:
You've been named coach of the week by a leading esports publication following {{team}}'s recent results.

The award recognizes your tactical decisions and the team's improved coordination on the Rift.

A well-deserved recognition for all the hard work.

media_pos_2.subject: Esportmaniacos: "{{team}} is a serious contender"
media_pos_2.body:
The Esportmaniacos program has named {{team}} as one of the most improved teams in the league.

"They've found an identity and they're sticking to it," the analyst commented during the show.

Your work is being noticed at the national level.

media_pos_3.subject: Interview: {{team}} coach on the rise
media_pos_3.body:
In a recent interview, the head coach of {{team}} discussed the team's philosophy and long-term vision.

The interview highlights the positive environment you've built and the trust the players have in your methods.

Fans are responding well to the new direction.

media_pos_4.subject: Analyst: {{team}} exceeding expectations
media_pos_4.body:
A well-known league analyst has published a glowing review of {{team}}'s performance, stating they are exceeding all pre-season expectations.

The analysis credits the coaching staff with creating a cohesive unit that punches above its weight.

High praise from one of the most respected voices in the scene.

media_pos_5.subject: Fan confidence at all-time high for {{team}}
media_pos_5.body:
A recent fan survey shows that confidence in {{team}} has reached an all-time high. Supporters are optimistic about the direction of the club.

Season ticket sales have increased, and social media engagement is up significantly.

The fans believe in what you're building.

media_pos_6.subject: "{{team}} is the dark horse of the split"
media_pos_6.body:
Multiple analysts are calling {{team}} the dark horse of the split. The team's recent performances have caught the attention of the entire league.

The article highlights your tactical flexibility and the squad's depth as key factors.

Respect is earned, and you're earning it.

media_pos_7.subject: {{team}} featured in positive documentary segment
media_pos_7.body:
A sports documentary series has featured {{team}} in a segment about successful team rebuilds. The piece interviews players and staff about the transformation.

The documentary highlights the culture shift you've implemented since taking charge.

Great publicity for the club.

media_pos_8.subject: {{player}} praised by media for recent form
media_pos_8.body:
{{player}} has received special praise from the media for their outstanding recent performances with {{team}}.

The coverage mentions that your coaching has been instrumental in unlocking {{player}}'s potential.

Player development is one of the key measures of a successful coach.

media_pos_9.subject: "{{team}} fans have reason to be excited"
media_pos_9.body:
A popular esports news site has published an article titled "Why {{team}} fans have reason to be excited."

The article breaks down the team's improved statistics and the positive trajectory under your leadership.

The wider community is starting to recognize the progress.

mediaPositive.subject: Positive Press — {{player}}
mediaPositive.body:
The local papers are running a very positive piece on {{player}} today.

They are highlighting their excellent recent form and commitment to {{team}}. This kind of coverage is great for the player's confidence and the club's image.

mediaNegative.subject: Negative Press — {{player}}
mediaNegative.body:
Some unflattering coverage of {{player}} appeared in the tabloids today.

Journalists are questioning their form and commitment to {{team}}. This could affect the player's morale — you might want to have a word.

intlCallup.subject: International Call-Up — {{player}}
intlCallup.body:
{{player}} has been called up to the {{nationality}} national team for an upcoming international window.

This is a great honor for the player and reflects well on the club. They'll be in good spirits when they return, though keep an eye on their fatigue levels.

community.body0:
{{team}} hosted a community open day at the training ground today.

Fans got to meet the players and watch a training session. The atmosphere was fantastic and it's done wonders for team spirit.
community.body1:
Several first-team players from {{team}} volunteered for a youth coaching session at a local school.

Great PR for the club, and the players seem energized by the experience.

moodReport.subject: Dressing Room Report — Mood: {{mood}}

boardConfidence.subject: Board Meeting — Results Under Scrutiny
boardConfidence.body0:
The board has called an urgent meeting. Three consecutive defeats have raised serious concerns about the team's direction.

"We need to see improvement quickly. The fans are restless and results must change."

How do you respond?
boardConfidence.body1:
After a string of poor results, the chairman has summoned you for a difficult conversation.

"We backed you with resources and time. The results simply aren't good enough. What's your plan?"

Choose your response carefully.

reassureBoard.label: Reassure them with a plan
reassureBoard.description: Present a clear strategy for turning things around. Buys you time.

acceptPressure.label: Accept responsibility
acceptPressure.description: Own the poor results. The board respects honesty.

blameCircumstances.label: Point to bad luck and tough matchups
blameCircumstances.description: Deflect blame to external factors. May or may not convince them.

fanPetition.subject: Fan Petition — Draft Identity
fanPetition.body:
A group of {{team}} supporters has organized a petition asking for a clearer draft identity and sharper objective setups.

"We want proactive plans on the Rift, not passive scaling every series. Show us the team knows how it wants to win."

Over 500 signatures so far. How do you respond?

listenFans.label: Engage with the fans
listenFans.description: Meet with fan representatives and listen to their concerns. Good for morale.

ignoreFans.label: Focus on the game
ignoreFans.description: Politely decline — game decisions stay within the team.

addressPublicly.label: Make a public statement
addressPublicly.description: Address the petition in a press conference. Transparent and proactive.

rival_1.subject: {{rival}} eyeing {{player}}
rival_1.body:
I've heard through the grapevine that {{rival}} is showing interest in {{player}}. They've been asking questions and may be preparing a bid.

Should we be concerned, or is {{player}} not for sale?

rival_2.subject: {{rival}} inquires about {{player}}
rival_2.body:
{{rival}} has made informal inquiries about {{player}}'s availability. They seem keen on strengthening their roster and see {{player}} as a target.

No formal offer yet, but I wanted to keep you informed.

rival_3.subject: {{rival}} scouting {{player}}
rival_3.body:
Our sources report that {{rival}} has been scouting {{player}} in recent matches. This usually precedes a transfer approach.

We should decide on our stance before they make a move.

rival_4.subject: {{rival}} wants {{player}}
rival_4.body:
Word around the league is that {{rival}} wants to sign {{player}}. Their manager is apparently a big admirer.

This could be serious — we may receive a formal offer soon.

rival_5.subject: {{rival}} monitors {{player}}'s contract
rival_5.body:
I've learned that {{rival}} is closely monitoring {{player}}'s contract situation. If we don't extend soon, they may try to capitalize.

Something to consider in our planning.

rival_6.subject: {{rival}} considering bid for {{player}}
rival_6.body:
{{rival}} is reportedly considering a bid for {{player}}. They see {{player}} as a key addition to their squad for the upcoming split.

I'll keep you posted if anything develops.

rival_7.subject: Rumor: {{rival}} interested in {{player}}
rival_7.body:
Transfer rumors are circulating that {{rival}} is interested in signing {{player}}. While it's just speculation for now, these rumors often have some truth behind them.

Thought you should know.

rival_8.subject: {{rival}} makes contact about {{player}}
rival_8.body:
{{rival}} has made initial contact regarding {{player}}. They've requested information about the player's availability and wage demands.

This could progress quickly. How do you want to handle it?

rival_9.subject: {{player}} attracting attention from {{rival}}
rival_9.body:
{{player}}'s performances have attracted attention from {{rival}}. They've been asking around about the player and seem genuinely interested.

We may need to make a decision on {{player}}'s future soon.

rival_10.subject: {{rival}} ready to move for {{player}}
rival_10.body:
Sources indicate that {{rival}} is ready to make a concrete move for {{player}}. A formal offer could arrive within days.

We should prepare our response.

rivalInterest.subject: Roster Rumour — {{player}} linked with {{rival}}
rivalInterest.body0:
We've received word that {{rival}} have started making moves for {{player}}.

Their staff were seen reviewing recent series and solo queue data, and sources suggest a formal approach could arrive soon.

How do you want us to respond if they make contact?

The player has drawn attention after recent stage performances. There is no formal bid yet, but pressure is building fast.

What's your stance?

notForSale.label: Not for sale
notForSale.description: Make it clear the player is going nowhere. Boosts their morale.

openToOffers.label: Open to offers
openToOffers.description: Signal willingness to negotiate. Player may become unsettled.

noComment.label: No comment
noComment.description: Stay quiet and let things play out. Neutral stance.

Boss, {{player}} has asked for a private meeting. They seem really down lately and want to talk about their situation at the club.

Their morale is at {{morale}} — you should address this before it affects the dressing room.
moraleCrisis.body1:
{{player}} has been looking dejected in training. They've requested a chat with you about their current state of mind.

Morale: {{morale}}. How you handle this could make or break their confidence.

Boss, {{player}} has come to see you. They're frustrated about their lack of game time in recent matches and want to know what they need to do to get back in the team.

benchComplaint.body1:
{{player}} knocked on your office door looking unhappy. They haven't featured in the last few matches and want answers.

"I came to this club to play. If I'm not in your plans, I'd rather you tell me straight."

happyPlayer.subject: {{player}} — Feeling Great
happyPlayer.body0:
{{player}} stopped by your office with a big smile. They're feeling great about their form and the team's direction.

"Just wanted to say I'm really enjoying the game right now, boss. The mood in the team is fantastic."

Your assistant mentions that {{player}} has been in excellent spirits lately. They approached you after training.

"Boss, I'm loving every minute here. Keep things going like this and I'll run through walls for you."

{{player}} has approached you regarding their contract situation. With only {{days}} days remaining on their deal, they want to know where they stand.

"Boss, my contract is running down. I need to know if I'm part of your plans going forward or if I should start looking elsewhere."

Your assistant flags that {{player}}'s contract expires in roughly {{months}} month(s). The player has been asking around the dressing room about their future.

jobRejection.subject: Application Update — {{team}}

The Esportmaníacos panel spent a good chunk of today's stream on {{player}} at {{team}}.

"Nothing to criticize this week. The guy is absolutely dominating the Rift: objective setups, draft execution, solo queue discipline, everything." The positive coverage should give confidence a boost in the team room.
positive.subject1: Esportmaníacos: {{player}} is carrying {{team}} through every Draft
positive.body1:
The Esportmaníacos tertulianos rarely agree on anything, but {{player}} got a full pass today: "Consistent, solid, no dips in form. From draft reads to objective setups, one of the best players in the league right now. {{team}} should do everything to keep him."

Good for morale — and for the market value.
positive.body2:
The desk circled back to {{player}} after reviewing {{team}}'s latest map setups: "This is the kind of player who makes the whole team look more ordered. Herald timer, dragon setup, reset timing; everything has intent."

Quiet praise, but the sort that staff rooms notice.
positive.body3:
Today's show had an unusual moment of agreement around {{team}}: "You can see the work. The drafts make sense, the players know their jobs, and {{player}} is setting the tone in-game. This is not random form."

The clip is already moving through fan chats.
positive.body4:
Esportmaníacos praised {{player}} for turning pressure moments into clean decisions: "Some players farm stats; this one wins the ugly minutes. If {{team}} need someone calm when the map gets weird, that's him."

That kind of narrative can settle a player before big matches.
positive.subject5: Esportmaníacos gives {{player}} credit for the turnaround
positive.body5:
The panel framed {{player}} as one of the reasons {{team}}'s week looked cleaner: "Less panic, better first moves, better discipline after losing tempo. You can tell someone is calling with confidence."

Staff will enjoy hearing this one.
positive.body6:
A draft segment on Esportmaníacos turned into praise for {{player}}: "The value is not one pick; it's the threat of five. {{team}} can enter draft with actual options because this player bends bans."

Good timing if renewal talks are near.
positive.subject7: Esportmaníacos says {{player}} is raising the floor
positive.body7:
The tertulia was impressed by how stable {{player}} has become for {{team}}: "He may not be the loudest name every week, but the floor is high. Coaches love that. Teams win splits with players who don't donate games."

Sensible coverage, for once.
positive.body8:
Esportmaníacos spent a full block on playoff ceilings and landed on {{player}}: "If {{team}} reaches playoffs, this is one of the players I trust in a best-of. He understands when to slow the map and when to flip tempo."

Useful fuel for the room.
positive.body9:
The panel admitted {{player}} had been underrated in the wider conversation: "We spend too much time on the flashy names. This guy has been doing the boring winning stuff for {{team}} all split. Give him credit."

A small media bump, but a deserved one.

negative.subject0: Draft Pressure on {{player}} — panel shows no mercy
negative.body0:

rules.title: How decay works
rules.played: A SoloQ day is a training day on any focus except Mental Reset. It adds 1 day to the grace period, up to {{cap}}, and wins back {{rec}} LP of decay.
rules.idle: An idle day uses 1 grace day. Idle means no team, or the Mental Reset focus, even on a rest day.
rules.loss: With the grace period used up, each idle day costs {{rate}} LP. LP never falls below Master 0 LP.
rules.neutral: Rest days and match days change nothing, so a regular starter never loses LP.
rules.noteOn: Shown at {{mode}}: {{rate}} LP lost per idle day, {{cap}}-day grace period, {{rec}} LP won back per SoloQ day. The daily LP drift of the formula continues.
rules.noteOff: Decay is off. With it on, these rules apply to every player in the save.
